workflow.title: How it works
workflow.step1: Draft with Helix or write / paste a Grafana panel JSON envelope in the editor.
workflow.step2: Click copy to clipboard to grab the JSON.
workflow.step3: In Grafana, choose add panel â†’ edit JSON and paste it in.
workflow.note: The browser never pushes panels to Grafana directly â€” you stay in control of what lands on your dashboards.

powerGrafana.intro: Build a Grafana panel JSON envelope against the curated panel-builder catalog below. The browser does not push the panel to Grafana; copy your JSON into your existing Grafana dashboard editor.

aiNarration.description: Get a short, Helix-written recap of your week from the digest data above.
aiNarration.title: Helix narration

aiBaseline.description: Compute statistical anomaly bounds (mean, stddev, p5/p95) from this vehicle's recent signal history and walk through how each signal compares to the static safe-range fallback.
aiBaseline.title: Learn per-vehicle baseline

aiExplanation.description: Generate independent, inferred narration for the selected vehicle over 30 days, not an explanation of the detector’s 7-day results or the baseline’s 14-day training data.
aiExplanation.emptyHint: Select a vehicle above to explain its anomalies.
aiExplanation.title: Helix explanation

aiBuilder.description: Describe the automation you want and get a typed graph draft you can review and save below.
aiBuilder.noPrompt: Describe the automation you want Helix to draft.
aiBuilder.noVehicle: Pick a vehicle above to let Helix draft an automation for it.
aiBuilder.placeholder: e.g. precondition the cabin to 22°C when I leave work on weekdays
aiBuilder.title: Draft from natural language

aiGeofenceAware.description: Describe an automation that uses one of your existing geofences. Helix proposes a typed graph anchored to a place_id you already have — review and apply to the form below before saving.
aiGeofenceAware.placeholder: e.g. when I arrive home on a weekday after sunset, turn on cabin overheat protection
aiGeofenceAware.title: Suggest a geofence-aware automation

aiNarrative.description: Ask Helix to explain which charging habits and risk factors drive your deterministic battery-health forecast. The narrator never changes the forecast — it grounds every sentence in the same numbers the chart below renders.
aiNarrative.title: Explain the battery health forecast

aiAgent.description: Ask Helix to propose a time-of-use-optimized charge schedule grounded in your selected rate plan and target departure. The schedule is never saved automatically — review the proposed window and click Schedule below to apply it.
aiAgent.emptyHint: Select a vehicle and a rate plan to draft a schedule.
aiAgent.title: Draft a schedule with Helix

aiClustering.description: Ask Helix to name and explain each deterministic charging-curve cluster fingerprint. The narrator never changes the cluster bucketing — it grounds every sentence in the same per-cluster numbers the curves below render.
aiClustering.emptyHint: Select a vehicle to explain its charging-curve clusters.
aiClustering.title: Explain the charging-curve cluster fingerprints

aiMlClustering.description: Compute per-cluster (L1 overnight / L2 workplace / DC fast) learned charging envelope from this vehicle's recent sessions and walk through how each cluster compares to the deterministic rule-label baseline used by the Charging curve page today.
aiMlClustering.title: Learn per-vehicle charging-curve clusters

aiDiagnosis.description: Get a 2-4 paragraph plain-language explanation of any flags raised on this charging session — trickle, expensive, low-power, or interrupted — generated from the same deterministic aggregation metrics shown above.
aiDiagnosis.title: Charging diagnosis

aiPreheatPrecool.description: Ask Helix to draft an advisory preheat or precool window using the departure heuristic and current temperatures. Helix does not save or apply a schedule. Review the proposal, then use the Vehicle command center for manual climate actions. Its Add precondition action uses a fixed 7 AM daily schedule, not the proposed window.
aiPreheatPrecool.emptyHint: Select a vehicle and confirm the cabin temperature, outside temperature, and departure time to draft a schedule.
aiPreheatPrecool.title: Suggest a preheat or precool schedule

aiNarrative.description: Ask Helix to explain the deterministic period-over-period analytics — which one or two metrics moved most between Period A and Period B, with directional phrasing keyed to the percent_change sign. The numbers are the same the chart and table below show; the narrator only explains them and is honest about zero-baseline windows and best-effort cost figures.
aiNarrative.noVehicleHint: Pick a vehicle to enable Helix narration.
aiNarrative.title: Narrate the period comparison

aiNarrative.description: Ask Helix to explain the deterministic charging-cost forecast — the historical trend, the projected cost / cost_low / cost_high band, the home-vs-supercharger split, and the deterministic insight. The dollar amounts are the same the chart below shows; the narrator only explains them and is honest that the band is an APPROXIMATE prediction interval, not a strict 95% confidence interval.
aiNarrative.title: Narrate the charging-cost forecast

aiSuggestions.description: Propose a typed repair plan (close, quarantine, or partial-update) for one stale charging session or drive from the inventory below. Helix never writes; review the proposal and use the matching baseline form to apply it.
aiSuggestions.title: Helix repair suggestions

byteRate.description: Recorded bytes per second; the displayed interval is explicit.
byteRate.label: Data rate

bytes.description: Recorded byte count, displayed with binary size units.
bytes.label: Data size

avgDuration.description: Existing average session duration calculation, expressed in canonical seconds.
avgDuration.label: Average session duration

energyAdded.description: Recorded energy added on included charging sessions.
energyAdded.label: Energy added

meanSessionPower.description: Arithmetic mean of finite session average powers; not peak power.
meanSessionPower.label: Mean session power

overallRate.description: Aggregate valid energy divided by corresponding positive duration; not mean session power.
overallRate.label: Overall charging rate

peakPower.description: Highest observed charging power; never a replacement for an average.
peakPower.label: Peak power

recordedCost.description: Recorded session costs, not tariff estimates or billing.
recordedCost.label: Recorded cost

sessions.description: Number of returned charging sessions included by the existing filter.
sessions.label: Sessions

count.description: Declared count, not inferred from an integer measurement.
count.label: Count

currency.description: Amount in its recorded denomination; no currency conversion.
currency.label: Cost

distance.description: Measured distance; canonical input is meters.
distance.label: Distance

duration.description: Elapsed duration; canonical input is seconds.
duration.label: Duration

efficiency.description: Consumption in watt-hours per meter; not reciprocal economy.
efficiency.label: Energy intensity

energy.description: Measured energy; canonical input is watt-hours.
energy.label: Energy

identifier.description: Source identifier, retained without grouping or rounding.
identifier.label: Identifier

latency.description: Recorded non-negative elapsed time in seconds, displayed in milliseconds or seconds.
latency.label: Latency

number.description: Unclassified numeric quantity; semantic meaning remains unknown.
number.label: Value

percent.description: Percentage input is already on the 0–100 scale.
percent.label: Percentage

power.description: Measured power; canonical input is watts.
power.label: Power

rate.description: Source-defined rate; the caller declares the quantity and time unit.
rate.label: Rate

score.description: Numeric score on a declared 100-point scale.
score.label: Score

fitStatus.description: Existing translated fit status; no invented eligibility threshold.
fitStatus.label: Fit status

inSampleRSquared.description: Existing dimensionless in-sample coefficient, not a percent.
inSampleRSquared.label: In-sample R²

includedDrives.description: Drive count admitted by the existing seasonal eligibility rules.
includedDrives.label: Included drives

observedIntensity.description: Existing observed consumption over included drives.
observedIntensity.label: Observed energy intensity

speed.description: Measured speed; canonical input is meters per second.
speed.label: Speed

status.description: Source-provided status, retained without numeric coercion.
status.label: Status

temperature.description: Absolute temperature in degrees Celsius; not a temperature difference.
temperature.label: Temperature

text.description: Source-provided text, retained without numeric coercion.
text.label: Text

aiCoaching.description: Get a 2-4 paragraph plain-language coaching summary of this drive — efficiency, regen use, and notable braking or acceleration moments — generated from the same per-drive metrics shown above.
aiCoaching.title: Drive coaching

aiSpeedProfile.description: Get a short plain-language interpretation of this drive’s speed regime distribution — city / suburban / highway buckets, outliers, and how the speed envelope compares to a typical drive — generated from the same per-drive aggregates shown in the chart.
aiSpeedProfile.title: Speed-profile insights

aiSearch.description: Describe a drive (for example "last Friday's trip to the coast") and jump straight to its replay — the assistant only narrates your own drives.
aiSearch.placeholder: Describe a drive — for example "last Friday's coast trip" or "the one with the lowest efficiency last week"
aiSearch.title: Find a drive in natural language

banner.body: This resource is open in another tab of this browser. Saving here will overwrite changes made there.
banner.bodyWithLabel: {{resource}} is open in another tab of this browser. Saving here will overwrite changes made there.
banner.switchHint: Or switch to your other tab to keep editing there.
banner.title: Another browser tab is editing this

aiRedaction.description: Ask Helix to recommend which PII classes to redact from a shared export. The recommendation is catalog-based — Helix never reads the rows of your export; it consults a deterministic per-export-type PII catalog and surfaces the highly-recommended redactions plus the optional ones that depend on your consent. Apply the recommendation by toggling the matching options in your export request.
aiRedaction.noTypeHint: Pick an export type to enable Helix.
aiRedaction.title: Plan PII redactions before sharing

aiSuggest.description: Propose a typed geofence draft (centroid, radius, and name) for this visited location based on its visit pattern. Review only — Helix never saves the geofence; you confirm and save via the existing baseline Add geofence form.
aiSuggest.title: Suggest a geofence for this location

helix.tooltip: Helix grounds responses in redacted TeslaSync data, application knowledge, and explicit tool evidence.

aiHelp.description: Ask a natural-language question about the application and the assistant will answer using the project’s own documentation, runbooks, and i18n strings — with explicit citations to each source.
aiHelp.inputLabel: Ask a question about the app
aiHelp.placeholder: e.g. How do I enable energy cost forecasting?
aiHelp.title: Ask the help assistant

aiSummary.description: Get a 3-6 sentence factual summary of this incident’s timeline. The summary is grounded in the same deterministic envelope the timeline below shows; the narrator never invents updates and never speculates about root cause.
aiSummary.title: Helix timeline summary

aiQA.description: Ask Helix a natural-language question about your all-time stats — total distance, charging savings, achievements, personal records. Answers are grounded in the same deterministic envelope the dashboard below shows; the narrator never invents numbers.
aiQA.noQuestion: Type a question to ask Helix about your lifetime stats.
aiQA.noVehicle: Select a vehicle to ask about its lifetime stats.
aiQA.placeholder: e.g. How far have I driven in total? How much have I saved on fuel?
aiQA.title: Ask about your lifetime stats

staleBanner.message: The live data connection has been offline for more than 2 minutes. Values on this page may be stale until the connection is restored.
staleBanner.title: Live data unavailable

aiSummary.description: Get a 3-6 sentence factual summary of the recent log and trace window. The narrator is grounded in a redacted envelope of the same window the table below shows; it never invents log lines and never speculates about root cause.
aiSummary.emptyHint: Waiting for a valid log window…
aiSummary.title: Helix log/trace summary

aiAutoName.description: Propose a concise, human-readable name for this visited location based on its visit pattern. Review only — Helix never saves the name; you confirm and save via the existing baseline form.
aiAutoName.title: Suggest a name for this location

aiPredictive.description: Get a 3-6 sentence factual narrative of upcoming maintenance risks. The advisor reads only the deterministic maintenance envelope (per-vehicle scheduled items, recent service records, current mileage when available) — VINs, coordinates, place names, IPs, and personal identifiers are redacted before the message reaches the provider. The narrative is informational; the reminders, status badges, and upcoming items list above remain the canonical raw view.
aiPredictive.title: Helix maintenance advisor

aiExplainer.description: Get a 3-6 sentence factual explanation of the current MQTT broker, SSE hub, and background-job state. The explainer reads only the deterministic broker-status envelope (broker connectivity, per-vehicle stream stats, SSE client counts, job freshness) — broker hostnames, ports, SSE client identifiers, and VINs are redacted before the message reaches the provider. The explanation is informational; the broker-status snapshot above remains the canonical raw view.
aiExplainer.emptyHint: A valid time window is required.
aiExplainer.title: Helix stream explainer

aiBuilder.description: Describe the alert you want to receive an advisory text proposal. Review it and manually enter the rule in the standard form before saving; this action does not fill the form, save, or enable an alert.
aiBuilder.title: Draft from natural language

aiConflicts.description: Surface structural overlaps between your alert rule definitions. Review only — Helix never edits, merges, or deletes rules.
aiConflicts.emptyMessage: No structural conflicts found in the current rule set.
aiConflicts.title: Detect cross-rule conflicts

aiTemplate.description: Ask Helix to write a distinctive Tesla-owner notification body from the alert dimensions you already selected — not a bland threshold line. Helix uses the same placeholder catalog as the editor and never saves — Apply copies the draft into the field below, then you click Save.
aiTemplate.emptyHint: Choose a signal or computed metric (and operator) first so Helix can ground the template.
aiTemplate.title: Suggest a message template

aiTuning.description: Review recent firings and propose a typed AlertRule patch. Descriptive replay only — review before saving.
aiTuning.title: Suggest lower-noise tuning

aiCategorize.description: Suggest categories through a separate recent-history request using the vehicle, severity, and rule filters supplied to this panel. The inbox or archive view and exact workspace date bounds do not filter this request; it uses its own lookback window (7 days by default). Review the proposal before applying its rule IDs as an inbox filter; this does not save categories or archive notifications.
aiCategorize.title: Suggest inbox categories

aiSuggestion.description: Ask Helix to recommend ONE quiet-hours window based on the trailing 30 days of your notification cadence. Helix never reads individual notification titles or messages — it consults a per-hour aggregate of non-critical events to find the sparsest interval. Apply the recommendation to seed the form below; you remain in control of the Save button.
aiSuggestion.previewExistingCount: You already have {{count}} quiet-hours window(s) configured.
aiSuggestion.previewInsufficientHistory: Helix had insufficient notification history; this is a conservative default.
aiSuggestion.title: Suggest a quiet-hours window from your notification history

operationalMode.writeBlocked: Return to live mode before making operational changes.

narrative.causeUnavailable: Cause is not established by the available evidence.
narrative.responseUnavailable: No action is recommended from this evidence alone.
narrative.title: Decision narrative
narrative.whyUnavailable: No defensible impact statement is available.

aiPredict.description: Compute per-bucket (temperature × speed) learned Wh/km from this vehicle's recent drives and walk through how each bucket compares to the static heuristic curve the projection uses today.
aiPredict.title: Learn per-vehicle range model

aiSuggestions.description: Get a short plain-language suggestion for lower-consumption habits and route choices grounded in your own historical route data — the dominant route, its kWh/100mi figure, a comparison across your other routes, and one or two concrete, non-mutating ideas you can try yourself.
aiSuggestions.emptyHint: Select a vehicle to generate route-efficiency suggestions.
aiSuggestions.title: Route-efficiency suggestions

aiExplainer.description: Ask Helix to explain the safety-related TeslaSync settings on this page in plain English. Helix only reads the typed envelope of canonical setting values (booleans, enum strings, HH:MM times) — it never reads notification titles, vehicle names, or any other PII, and it never proposes or changes a setting. Use the controls below to update a value yourself; Helix only narrates.
aiExplainer.title: Explain my safety settings

savedViews.makeDefault: Apply automatically when I open this page
savedViews.name: Name
savedViews.title: Saved views

aiSearch.description: Describe what you are looking for and the assistant will surface drives, charging sessions, and alerts that match — citing each entity by name.
aiSearch.title: Search with natural language

aiTripPostcard.description: Ask Helix to draft a propose-only image prompt and preview spec for the selected trip's share card. Helix only sees the redacted trip context (distance, duration, drive count, vehicle name) — never raw coordinates or street addresses. The draft is never published automatically; review it here, then use the existing Share button on the trip to publish a static share card.
aiTripPostcard.noTripHint: Pick a trip from the list above to enable Helix.
aiTripPostcard.title: Draft a Helix share-card image

aiNarration.description: Ask Helix to walk through your firmware update history — the current version, the install cadence, and the headline release-note themes. The narrator quotes only the deterministic update events your vehicle reported plus public Tesla release notes for the versions you have installed; it never invents firmware versions or claims features your installed build does not have.
aiNarration.noVehicleHint: Pick a vehicle above to enable Helix.
aiNarration.title: Summarize my software update history

l1.desc: Read from the in-process SignalStore (hot path, freshest).

l2.desc: Read from Redis cross-pod cache (legacy entry; freshness unknown).

stale.desc: Redis-backed value older than the 2-minute freshness window.
stale.label: Stale

aiNarrator.description: Get a 3-6 sentence factual narration of the current vehicle FSM transition trace. The narrator reads only the deterministic FSM envelope (vehicle id, window bounds, per-FSM-name counts, per-edge counts, flap count, transition stream) — VINs, coordinates, place names, IPs, and personal identifiers are redacted before the message reaches the provider. The narration is informational; the transition table, state diagram, and FSM health panel above remain the canonical raw view.
aiNarrator.emptyHint: Select a vehicle and a valid time window first.
aiNarrator.title: Helix FSM narrator

aiNarration.description: Ask Helix to explain the deterministic operating-cost evidence below. Lifetime equivalent gas cost is derived from positive-drive distance, configured gas price per unit, and comparison MPG; only monthly equivalent gas rows estimate distance from recorded-cost charging energy. The layer also discloses the positive-cost charging filter, the flat $50-per-modeled-month maintenance heuristic, and the excluded ownership costs.
aiNarration.noVehicleHint: Pick a vehicle above to enable Helix.
aiNarration.title: Explain my lifetime operating cost

aiNarrative.description: Ask Helix to explain how outside ambient temperature affects this vehicle's efficiency — which temperature bucket runs most efficiently, how cold-weather months compare with mild-weather months, and what the seasonal pattern in the chart implies. The bucket and monthly numbers are the same the chart below shows; the narrator only explains them and is honest that these are descriptive aggregates of recent drives, not a forecast.
aiNarrative.emptyHint: Select a vehicle to narrate its temperature impact.
aiNarrative.title: Narrate the cabin-temperature impact

aiTrendReasoning.description: Ask Helix to explain the recent 30-day trend in this vehicle's four corner tire pressures — which tires are trending up, down, or stable, the most likely deterministic driver of any deviation (cold-weather correlation, all-tires-trending suggesting weather rather than puncture, single-corner slow-leak signature), and any actionable threshold crossing. The per-corner pressures and thresholds are the same the gauges below show; the narrator only explains them and is honest that the slope is a descriptive linear extrapolation, not a forecast.
aiTrendReasoning.title: Narrate the 30-day tire-pressure trend

account.success: Account export queued — track progress in the floating widget

aiAgent.description: Ask Helix to draft a trip plan grounded in your past charging history along the corridor. The plan is never saved automatically — review the proposed plan and click Plan in the form below to save it.
aiAgent.noDestination: Set a destination for Helix to plan the route to.
aiAgent.noOrigin: Set a starting point for Helix to plan the route from.
aiAgent.noVehicle: Select a vehicle to let Helix draft a trip plan.
aiAgent.title: Draft a plan with Helix

aiSuggestName.description: Get a short, propose-only name suggestion grounded in this trip’s route context (start and end places, drive count, distance, time window). The suggestion is never saved automatically — review the proposed name in the panel and click Save to apply it.
aiSuggestName.title: Suggest a trip name

aiNarrative.description: Ask Helix to explain the deterministic vampire-drain signal — the recent average / worst idle-drain rate, the most-correlated per-event driver (Sentry, climate, long park), and whether the recent rate is in line with the typical fleet. The numbers are the same the cards below show; the narrator only explains them and surfaces the inference's correlational nature honestly.

aiPaintPreview.description: Ask Helix to draft a propose-only paint-color image prompt for this vehicle. Helix only sees the redacted vehicle context (model, trim, current exterior color) — never the display name, VIN, license plate, or location. The draft is never applied automatically; review the proposed image prompt here, then use the existing Color setting below to apply the new paint if you'd like to keep it.

voiceMode.description: Speak to Helix and hear the reply out loud. Voice input and playback both stay on this device — only the transcribed text is sent to the assistant, never the raw audio.

watchFaceNL.description: Ask Helix a glance-style natural-language question about your vehicle right now — battery, range, charging, locks, climate, recent alerts. Helix only reads a typed snapshot of canonical state values; it never claims to have changed a setting or sent a vehicle command. To lock, unlock, start climate, or send another command use the watch-face tap icons or the phone app.
watchFaceNL.placeholder: e.g. how is my battery? Is the car locked? Leave empty for a summary.
watchFaceNL.title: Ask Helix about your watch face
